description: The references by the piece: with topic alone, its Essentials (the rules for that step) and its section list; with section, that one section (a number, a name, or a sub-heading such as a component or a command); with find, every line that mentions all the words. No arguments lists the topics. Read what the step needs, not whole files.

all.description: the whole file (large; prefer a section)

find.description: words to find (every word must be on the line)

section.description: a section number or name, e.g. 3, count-up, showtime check

topic.description: a reference: components, render, story, launch (the launch workflow), data-story, manim ...

name: guide
title: Read the showtime references
